title: Fear Will Keep Them In Line
caption: Fear Will Keep Them In Line (V)
game_text: Unless {icon:virtual-set symbol} Fear Will Keep Them In Line on table (even if suspended), deploy on Death Star. During your control phase, for each battleground system controlled by your Star Destroyer within 2 parsecs of Death Star, opponent loses 2 Force .
lore: “The regional governors now have direct control over their territories. Fear will keep the local systems in line. Fear of this battle station.”
base_page: Fear Will Keep Them In Line
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Non-unique (no dot). The slip prints the orange/gold Original Virtual set sphere INLINE after 'Unless' (i.e. unless the (V) version of this card is on table) → transcribed as {icon:virtual-set symbol}; no token exists for it yet. The slip prints a stray space before the final period ('2 Force .') — kept as printed. Lore corrected from scan: the quotation is in curly double quotes “ ” (wiki uses straight single quotes). Base scan 745 px (Premiere-D-fearwillkeeptheminline.gif) carries a 'D-E1' label (Decipher Glossary 2.0 errata printing: 'system or sector') — top half is the printed face; copyright line legible: 1995. The 350 px printed archive face (Premiere-D-fearwillkeeptheminline-decipher-archive.gif; wiki page 'Fear Will Keep Them In Line (Original)', same lore/destiny) also downloaded to src/vs2/, not used. No modern or Block remake found on the wiki (searched V*/VB*/VSh*/VD* Dark image names) — modern null.
